title: Writing profiles
description: Use different prompts and cleanup settings for each destination. Domain rules precede app rules, then defaults. Higher priority wins within each group; equal priorities use a stable ID order.
overrideHelp: Choose a profile to use for every destination. Automatic selection is the default. Deleted or disabled selections fall back to automatic. Changes apply to your next recording.
captureHelp: Start capture, then switch to the target app within three seconds. App identity is captured separately from field text. Browser domains and selected text depend on the app's accessibility support and system permissions. On Linux, the app must expose AT-SPI accessibility, including in Wayland sessions.
includeText: Read selected text and verify its field locally. Some systems retain a bounded field snapshot to check replacement; only selected text is used for commands. Password and secure fields are excluded.
switchNow: Switch to the target app now…
name: Name
preferenceHelp: Matching preferences are added to post-processing. Blank scopes apply everywhere. All filled scopes must match. Language codes also match regional variants.
